Tabletop Simulator Art

These images are for play mats and card backs to use in Magic: The Gathering on Tabletop Simulator. The play mats are actually upside down so they face folks across the table from me. Clicking the Copy button copies the text to put into Tabletop Simulator to use the image.

Here's an example of what the images look like in place:

(this is for my angels deck. hence the image)

Card Backs

Reminder: You have to set the card back URL before importing the deck. Click the gear icon in the importer and set the Card Back URL field. Then, add the Deck Site URL under the "Deck" tab. Images will squish in so the aspect ratio of the source images doesn't matter.

Play Mats

NOTE: The alt text for the images isn't descriptive. The process that builds the page isn't set up for that.
